question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `append` as an optional built-in write-tool parameter and `SandboxFsBridge.appendFile` as a public Plugin SDK capability?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but code review cannot decide whether these new model-facing and external plugin contracts are the product’s intended long-term API.

options.title: Accept the additive contracts
options.body: Land the opt-in tool parameter and optional bridge capability after owner review and exact-head checks.

options.title: Keep append core-internal
options.body: Retain the native append implementation but remove the public Plugin SDK expansion if external bridges should not receive this contract.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Do not establish an append API until maintainers choose a different broader file-safety design.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive contracts
recommendation.body: Land the opt-in tool parameter and optional bridge capability after owner review and exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history most directly connects Peter to the central agent-tool schema and implementation surfaces requiring this API decision.
